office_does: The treasurer collects property taxes, manages and invests county funds and banks for the county's taxing districts; this ballot fills the short and full four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: interim Treasurer Emily Sabo, appointed in May 2026 after Vickie Clelland retired, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Lifelong county resident from North Bonneville, appointed interim Treasurer in May 2026; running as a Republican.
highlights: Appointed interim treasurer by the commissioners from May 18, 2026 [S2]
Stresses fiscal responsibility and careful management of public funds [S1]
